description: Defines the absl::CordBuffer class for managing memory buffers used in constructing large Cord data structures, including methods for creating buffers with default or custom size limits, and handling internal representations with small size optimization (SSO).

classes.name: CordBuffer
classes.description: A move-only class managing memory buffers for building large Cord data structures, with methods for creation, data access, and size management.

methods.name: CreateWithDefaultLimit
methods.description: Creates a CordBuffer with capacity capped at the default limit.

methods.name: CreateWithCustomLimit
methods.description: Creates a CordBuffer with capacity rounded to a power of two, up to a specified block size.

methods.name: MaximumPayload
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size for a CordBuffer.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns a span of available capacity in the buffer.

methods.name: available_up_to
methods.description: Returns a span limited to a specified size of available capacity.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data for writing.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current length of data in the buffer.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: IncreaseLengthBy
methods.description: Increases the data length by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the data length to a specified value.
